propositions: REBAR_LLM_MODEL is superseded by per-class configuration (model_classes) and must be deprecated with a scheduled removal window at v1.0.0, not kept as a permanent alias.

The deprecation must be registered in _deprecations.REGISTRY via _scheduled() with permanent=False and remove_in=_MAJOR, and must emit warnings through warn_deprecated at every env-read site to enable registry tracking and doc generation.

A bare REBAR_LLM_MODEL without explicit class configuration must resolve to all three classes (FRONTIER, AGENT, GATE) at the precedence point where per-field defaults are applied, with CLI > per-class env > config table > REBAR_LLM_MODEL > built-in default.

The deprecation warning must be emitted at both env-read sites: config.py:469 (when config.from_env() reads it) and model_classes.py (when load_class_slots/parse_class_slots resolve the fallback default), with exactly one warning per load_class_slots() call.

User-facing strings in argparse descriptions, MCP tool descriptions, and module docstrings must remove REBAR_LLM_MODEL as the documented current interface and direct users to class-based configuration instead.
